text: dsh-session-title-idle-refresh 是一款面向 DSH web profile 的会话标题插件。它注册会话标题提供方，用会话中的多条用户消息生成标题，并定时检查闲置会话；当标题未覆盖最新消息且会话达到闲置阈值时，插件调用刷新流程，使标题跟上后续对话。它支持设置扫描间隔、闲置时长、最低消息数和每轮刷新上限，也会保留用户手动命名的标题并跳过子会话。插件通过 bundle 替换默认标题提供方，适合希望长对话标题能在空闲后更新的 DSH web 用户。

dsh-session-title-idle-refresh is a DSH web plugin that titles sessions from human messages. It refreshes stale titles after idle time, preserves renamed titles, and skips child sessions. Users can configure its scan interval and idle threshold.
想让长时间没动的 DSH 会话标题自动跟上后来聊的内容
Can session titles catch up with later messages after the conversation has been idle?
dsh-session-title-idle-refresh 的功能「闲置后刷新标题」：定时扫描闲置会话，在标题未覆盖最新用户消息时刷新标题。达到配置的闲置时长和最低消息数后触发，每轮刷新数量有限；用户手动改名的标题和子会话会跳过。
dsh-session-title-idle-refresh 使用会话当前路由的 LLM 生成标题，所选用户消息会作为模型输入；数据发送到何处取决于该路由配置。
dsh-session-title-idle-refresh 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 17 天；提交数 5；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-session-title-idle-refresh README · dsh-session-title-idle-refresh：- Registers the session-title provider with `automatic: "first-prompt"` —
  the initial title is generated exactly once, as with the stock
  provider — but generation reads **all** human messages (stock
  all-prompts policy, including its keep-an-adequate-title stability
  rules, with the input trimmed to the byte budget).
- A timer scans live sessions every `scanMs`. A session is refreshed
  once via `ctx.sessionTitle.refresh()` when **all** hold:
  - its title does not yet cover the latest human message,
  - the last event and the last human message are older than `idleMs`
    (default 30 min),
  - it has at least `minMessages` human messages (default 2),
  - it is not a subagent child session,
  - its title is not user-pinned (rename).
  Attempts per uncovered tail are recorded in memory; a refresh is
  never retried for the same tail before `max(idleMs, 30min)` passes.

dsh-session-title-idle-refresh README · Install (web profile)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-title-idle-refresh

dsh-session-title-idle-refresh README · then restart dsh web：```

The package ships a bundle patch (`cordis.patch.yml`) that inserts
the provider row with the defaults below and disables the stock
`session-title-llm` row — only one title provider may be registered,yaml
- id: session-title-idle-refresh
  config:
    idleMs: 1800000
    scanMs: 60000
```

dsh-session-title-idle-refresh README · Config defaults：idleMs 1800000 · scanMs 60000 · minMessages 2 · maxPerScan 3 ·
targetWords 5 · targetCjkCharacters 10 · maxInputBytes 16384 ·
maxOutputTokens 4096 · timeoutMs 60000. No provider/model is pinned:
titles use each session's own logged route, like the stock provider.

idle, for the session-title service) was prototyped against
deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness and is kept here as
